notes: The CSV export formats tools/import-metrics.mjs understands, read from the script source (not from real exports).
The script's header comment names inbox folders 'instagram-elevate'/'youtube-elevate', which pre-date the 9-account structure; any folder name is accepted as the account.

output_file.row_key: account + '|' + (link or title + '|' + published); a newer export updates numbers in place
output_file.missing_values: a missing column stays blank, never a fake 0

inbox.convention: reports/inbox/<account>/*.csv; the folder name says whose numbers they are; imported files move to reports/inbox/processed/<date>/<account>/
inbox.header_matching: case-insensitive; first an exact header match for any listed name, then a 'contains' match, in the listed order
detection_order: youtube if any header contains 'video title' or 'watch time'
instagram if any header contains 'permalink', 'reach' or 'post type'
otherwise skipped ('not an Instagram or YouTube export I recognise')
inbox.parsing: RFC 4180 CSV; BOM stripped; blank rows dropped; numbers strip ',', '%' and spaces; dates parsed by Date.parse and written as YYYY-MM-DD

records.export_origin: Meta Business Suite > Insights > Content > Export (CSV)
records.verification: tested on sample data only per the content OS notes; no real export exists in reports/inbox

records.export_origin: YouTube Studio > Analytics > Advanced mode > Export > CSV ('Table data.csv')

transforms.link: https://youtu.be/<content id> when the Content column is non-empty
transforms.format: 'short (<=3 min)' if duration <= 180 s, 'video' otherwise, blank if no duration
transforms.title: truncated to 120 characters

records.verification: tested on sample data only per the content OS notes; no real export exists in reports/inbox
